dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've crossed blades with Kamisato Ayato...

dialogues.speaker: Nobumori
dialogues.text: *sigh* That was my youthful ignorance... Please forget about it.

dialogues.speaker: Nobumori
dialogues.text: In my current job, I probably won't be needing a sword or spear. My skills with the spear are probably of little use. If you don't mind, please accept it.
